quotes.quote: Map Ubuntu binary package names to their corresponding source package names.
Ubuntu vulnerability advisories in OSV are indexed by source package name rather than binary package name.
allowing callers such as scanners to query OSV using the resulting source package names.
The Ubuntu release ecosystem (e.g. Ubuntu:24.04, Ubuntu:24.04:LTS, or Ubuntu:Pro:24.04:LTS).
A non-empty array of Ubuntu binary package names (maximum 1000 per request).
with an empty object {} for binary package names that have no known source package mappings in that Ubuntu release
